{{Otheruses|Fleet Intelligence}}
'''Fleet Intelligence''' was a branch of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Navy]] responsible for coordinating the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] [[deep picket line]], as well as interpreting information passed on by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Fleet Intelligence was under the control of the [[Commander of Fleet Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
